title: Is power of two
statementMd:
Return `True` if the integer `n` is a positive power of two.

**Example:** `is_power_of_two(16)` returns `true`.
hints: A power of two has exactly one bit set: `n & (n - 1) == 0`.
solutionMd:
```python
def is_power_of_two(n):
    return n > 0 and n & (n - 1) == 0
```

Clearing the lowest bit leaves zero only for powers of two.
referenceSolution:
